name: SComm local vault
description: Offline VEK unwrap, fail-closed critical extensions, generation chain, and merge. Does not call a vault host. Pepper-only unlock is outside this profile.
rules: unknown-critical-extension fails with ERR_CRITICAL_EXTENSION (device-bound custody uses this rule)
stale-generation is not adopted as a newer head
merge status severity is monotonic (compromised > revoked > retired > active)
merge-conflict fails with ERR_MERGE_MSK rather than last-writer-wins
